instruction: Establish local folders called PROJECTS and CLIENTS in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Variation 0: Changed folder names from COMPANY/UNIVERSITY to PROJECTS/CLIENTS. Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird. Evaluator checks for folder existence by verifying both .msf index files and folder directories via ls command output. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match folder names.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses postconfig to capture folder state via 'ls -R' on the Thunderbird Local Folders directory
Complete coverage: checks both required folders (PROJECTS and CLIENTS)
Appropriate verification approach: checks both .msf index files and folder directories, which is how Thunderbird stores local folders
Correct data flow: postconfig saves ls output to cache file, get_cache_file retrieves it, check_list applies regex patterns
Regex patterns will work in practice but could be more robust - the pattern '\bPROJECTS/?(?!\.msf)' uses negative lookahead after optional slash which may not be the clearest approach
Runtime feasibility confirmed: ls command can execute, cache file can be saved/retrieved, and check_list can parse text output
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider simplifying regex patterns for directory matching - instead of '\bPROJECTS/?(?!\.msf)', could use clearer alternatives like '\bPROJECTS:' (matching ls -R directory headers) or '\bPROJECTS\s*$' to match directory names on their own line
Could add 'unexpect' patterns to ensure no error messages appear in the ls output (e.g., 'No such file', 'Permission denied')
